svg.text: Terrain authoring — 4 / 4: Save terrain as, saving again, and Edit terrain… (DESIGN_Terrain_Authoring.md §13–§14, R-4200)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
Save terrain — only in a terrain source; overwrites
the terrain it produced, after ② (W-4).
Save terrain as… — a new terrain from any scenario.
6.1 km of walls, fences and hedges
damage to 3 houses from a test run — not baked (E-6)
empty of the baked blocks; units are not copied (E-5)
scenario that will see the change.
③ Edit terrain… (§14) — a terrain's right-click menu (shown for two terrains at once). A terrain with a SOURCE badge reopens its block scenario
(the ground → blocks → baked chain is kept in its folder, E-1);
an imported terrain gets a new source the first time — only additions, its own houses stay baked (E-3). The editor's title then says TERRAIN SOURCE (E-2).
Removing an already-baked house is designed, not built (E-Q).
